name: prismic-react-workspace
description: Workspace for prismic-react library and demo website

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/prismic-react && npm run build -w packages/demo-website
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/prismic-react && npm run lint -w packages/demo-website
scripts.ci:simulate: npm run ci:deps && npm run ci:lint && npm run ci:typecheck && npm run ci:test && npm run ci:build && npm run ci:e2e && npm run ci:package-health
scripts.ci:info:
echo '
🚀 CI Simulation Tasks:
  ci:simulate - Run complete CI pipeline
  ci:deps - Install dependencies
  ci:lint - Run linting
  ci:typecheck - Run TypeScript checking
  ci:test - Run unit tests
  ci:test:coverage - Run tests with coverage
  ci:build - Build packages
  ci:e2e - Run E2E tests
  ci:package-health - Check package health
  ci:package-size - Check package size
  ci:package-test - Test package installation
'
scripts.ci:lint: echo '🔍 Running linting...' && npm run lint
scripts.ci:typecheck: echo '📝 Running type checking...' && npm run typecheck
scripts.ci:test: echo '🧪 Running unit tests...' && npm run test
scripts.ci:test:coverage: echo '📊 Running tests with coverage...' && npm run test:coverage
scripts.ci:build: echo '🏗️ Building packages...' && npm run build
scripts.ci:e2e: echo '🎭 Running E2E tests...' && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ci:package-health: npm run ci:package-size && npm run ci:package-test
scripts.ci:package-size: echo '📦 Checking package size...' && cd packages/prismic-react && npm pack --dry-run && ls -la dist/
scripts.ci:package-test: echo '🔬 Testing package installation...' && cd packages/prismic-react && npm pack --quiet && cd ../demo-website && rm -f prismic-react-*.tgz && cp ../prismic-react/prismic-react-*.tgz . && npm install ./prismic-react-*.tgz && npm run build && rm -f prismic-react-*.tgz
